idea: 极端尾部高斯隔离配对策略。仅选取美国敞口在全市场前10%（纯海外暴露）与后10%（纯国内防御）的标的，通过高斯分位数拉伸极端值并在行业内归一化，构造零行业偏差的地理纯多头与纯空头配对信号，中段噪音置零。
expression_list: trade_when(or(greater(rank(winsorize(if_else(is_nan(rsk74_raw_exp_usa), 0, rsk74_raw_exp_usa), std=4)), 0.9), less(rank(winsorize(if_else(is_nan(rsk74_raw_exp_usa), 0, rsk74_raw_exp_usa), std=4)), 0.1)), group_normalize(quantile(winsorize(if_else(is_nan(rsk74_raw_exp_usa), 0, rsk74_raw_exp_usa), std=4), driver="gaussian"), industry), 0)
